articles.title_en: German investigators suspect Russian military intelligence organized an arson attack near defense firms in Munich
articles.lead_en: German investigators believe the Main Directorate of the General Staff of Russia’s Armed Forces, or GRU, was behind a September 3 attack on defense companies in Munich, the Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung reported.
